notes.title: Notice of User Experience Optimization and Update for "Shadow of Fear: Season 2"
notes.notes: [p]Based on feedback and criticism from users, this update has optimized a large number of user experience features[/p][p]Including but not limited to the following functions:[/p][p][/p][h3]1： Change the game pause interface again[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/7a11d8773b0ca0ca5b018ad371fee67a8963ea4f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]2： Revise the game settings interface[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/2de7b79c45fa08fe8ca99bce786091a193c850b1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]3： Add and improve game settings with more features[/h3][p]1. Game screen detail settings;[/p][p]2. User defined button function (beta);[/p][p]3. Adjustable game volume function;[/p][p][/p][h3]4： Optimize the main page mechanism of the game[/h3][p]Players only need to press any key when logging into the game for the first time, and after that, they do not need to operate again to exit from any level, and can directly enter the main page[/p][p][/p][h3]5： Game performance optimization[/h3][p]1. notes.title: Notice of Resumption, Update and Operation of 'Shadow of Fear'
The fully remastered version of "Evil Spirit Yard" has now been launched
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support!
The updated content is as follows:

[h1][b]1、 Brand new map[/b][/h1]
[b][h3]"Comprehensive Remake" of "Evil Spirit Yard"[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/54d21c759a22618ab0149cfa03a72bcea938a84c.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/3a32aa220994ab937db08dc6a2edccc85ff97270.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/56e5fc1ab861d795462863ac744d905f44240251.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]2、 Brand new menu UI[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/ece70fa744ebf56a1ffe5819b5fc887d8e4da297.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/c2e0fc97ad3c788b3dc6ca8e2725159c9bdbf398.png[/img]

[h1][b]3、 New features[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]Customize main page music[/b][/h3]
Now players can find the note button in the upper right corner and customize the music that has been updated in the history of Shadow of Fear. The music will continue to be added in the future

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/ac2d5c41a56edd571117ca5ecfa0d8d59c3dca23.png[/img]

[h1][b]4、 UI optimization[/b][/h1]
Nowadays, the UI of players is more concise, and the buttons are also displayed on the screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/acbccd5312cd983fb15a10e5bff37b7b5954b57a.png[/img]

[h1][b]5、 Game optimization and bug fixing[/b][/h1]

1. Optimized the character's sliding shovel action, now players can perform "sliding shovel cancellation"

2. Fixed the issue in "Atlas" where players would fall out of the map;

3. Fixed the issue of soul gladiators not appearing in Dueling Ground;

4. Game performance optimization, with approximately 3 frames of performance prompt;

5. Optimized the function of players holding and switching aiming;

Thank you all for your support. Let's keep up the momentum of Shadow of Fear!

notes.title: Shadow of Fear Season 2 Regular Update
notes.notes:
《恐惧之影》第二季
经过大部分网友粉丝的建议与反馈
决定优化以下内容：

[h3]一、游戏性能方面[/h3]

1，优化了蓝图逻辑，整体性能提升3帧；

2，优化了部分大型计算逻辑，先这样游戏帧数稳定，游戏越玩越卡的情况不再出现；

[h3]二，游戏BUG方面[/h3]

1，解决了子弹数不合理的问题；

2，解决了切枪卡顿严重的问题；

3，解决了切枪武器模型出乱的问题；

[h3]三，游戏机制方面[/h3]

[h3]1，现在玩家跑步状态下购买物品不会强制降低速度；

2，现在玩家跑步时瞄准结束不会卡视野；

[b]感谢各大网友粉丝们的反馈！
《恐惧之影》再接再厉！[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710422/6d5d8839897439a9c4dfd39eef41467c55c630e4.png[/img]
